left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Receiving HHD  [OR] or ICHDF for more than 3 months  [AND] and less than 36 months

right.raw_text: -  Haemoglobin equal to or greater than100 g/L at enrolment

left.raw_text:
-  Willing  [AND] and physically able to undertake the study assessments/ [OR] tests
  -  Willing to provide blood for storage and future analysis
  -  Able to give informed consent
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Living donor transplant  [OR] or change to peritoneal dialysis planned
  -  Physical assessments contraindicated for the following clinical reasons
       -  Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS) within the last 3 months (chest pain, [OR]  ECG changes  [OR] or typical biomarker elevation)

right.raw_text:
-  Any current uncontrolled cardiac dysrhythmias causing symptoms (chest pain, [OR]  palpitations, [OR]  syncope  [OR] or dizziness)
       -  Symptomatic aortic stenosis
       -  New York Heart Association grade IV Heart failure
       -  Severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
       -  Acute pulmonary embolus  [OR] or pulmonary infarction in the last 3 months
       -  Current acute myocarditis  [OR] or pericarditis
       -  Suspected  [OR] or known dissecting aneurysm
       -  Acute systemic infection, [AND]  accompanied by fever, [OR]  body aches  [OR] or swollen lymph glands
  -  Pregnancy
  -  Life expectancy of less than twelve months
